title: Took a break, by break, never really started the h-resume remix for my students, it was a good cause....On a rainy day my son said he had an app idea
summary: Took a break, by break, never really started the h-resume remix for my students, it was a good cause....On a rainy day my son said he had an app idea and wanted to try. We did. He wrote about here: http://dogzone.jgregorymcverry.com/2018/update-on-my-app
